derivation: inc2 at B=3 computes (x+1 mod 4,0). D contains x, initial target, initial fault (2+2+4 bits), hence 256 complete tuples. Each becomes (x,tgt XOR ((x+1) mod 4),fault). Exhaustively comparing all of D with the same scheduled construction earns proof; input-only coverage would be evidence (§12.2).
